company.name: Rise Reforming
company.shortDescription: Rise Reforming converts stranded biogas from various sources like wastewater plants and farms into valuable chemicals on-site.
company.description: Rise Reforming develops technology to convert stranded biogas and post‑industrial plastic waste into useful chemicals. The company designs modular plants that fit inside shipping containers to process raw biogas from wastewater facilities, farms, and landfills on site. Its systems produce chemicals such as dimethyl ether and methanol for downstream industrial uses. Rise Reforming focuses on replacing fossil fuel–derived feedstocks with waste‑based inputs for chemical production. Its process is intended for biogas producers, waste management operators, and industrial partners seeking low‑carbon chemical sourcing and utilization of existing waste streams.
